targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS sessions FROM session WHERE day BETWEEN ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz)::date AND ($__timeTo()::timestamptz)::date

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tag WHERE day BETWEEN ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz)::date AND ($__timeTo()::timestamptz)::date) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enhanced_tag WHERE start_day BETWEEN ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz)::date AND ($__timeTo()::timestamptz)::date) AS tags
SELECT COUNT(*) AS periods FROM rest_mode_period WHERE start_day <= ($__timeTo()::timestamptz)::date AND COALESCE(end_day, ($__timeTo()::timestamptz)::date) >= ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz)::date
SELECT COALESCE(type, 'unknown') AS type, COUNT(*) AS sessions FROM session WHERE day BETWEEN ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz)::date AND ($__timeTo()::timestamptz)::date GROUP BY type

SELECT day AS "Date", type AS "Type", mood AS "Mood", start_datetime AS "Started", ROUND((EXTRACT(epoch FROM end_datetime - start_datetime) / 60.0)::numeric, 1) AS "Minutes" FROM session WHERE day BETWEEN ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz)::date AND ($__timeTo()::timestamptz)::date ORDER BY start_datetime DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT timestamp AS "Time", 'Tag' AS "Format", COALESCE(tags::text, text) AS "Label", text AS "Comment" FROM tag WHERE day BETWEEN ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz)::date AND ($__timeTo()::timestamptz)::date UNION ALL SELECT start_time, 'Enhanced', COALESCE(custom_name, tag_type_code), comment FROM enhanced_tag WHERE start_day BETWEEN ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz)::date AND ($__timeTo()::timestamptz)::date ORDER BY "Time" DESC

SELECT start_day AS "Start", end_day AS "End", COALESCE(end_day, CURRENT_DATE) - start_day + 1 AS "Days", jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(episodes, '[]'::jsonb)) AS "Episodes" FROM rest_mode_period WHERE start_day <= ($__timeTo()::timestamptz)::date AND COALESCE(end_day, ($__timeTo()::timestamptz)::date) >= ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz)::date ORDER BY start_day DESC
